cohesionAudit: Increment 1 delivers independently useful daily source-to-artifact/AI workflow coverage and fixes, including first consumers of its finite manifest/harness; there is no separate test-only foundation increment.

Increment 2 delivers an independent asset-to-system/release outcome over immutable asset/build/runtime boundaries. Its breadth and safe rollback justify a separate review from the independent Data/Context/model subsystems.

Increment 3 owns actual operational UI consumers and cross-surface fault/accessibility behavior plus current host/managed environment admission. It is not merely a report or test-only tail; its environment and recovery risks justify the qualification boundary.
defectLoop: Locate the current implemented/tested contract and exact user outcome.
Reproduce through the relevant actual UI or focused architectural boundary and retain the failing result.
Add a red regression when practical; distinguish product bug from fixture, unsupported capability, environment and new design decision.
Repair the owning layer without weakening authority, integrity, resource bounds or existing functionality.
Run the exact regression and relevant host journey; retain first failure/retries and document the changed behavior.
Obtain current scoped checks and genuine independent review; commit only coherent owned reviewed changes after all live claims are released.

resourcePlan.inferenceParallelism: No concurrent model inference, performance sampling or package/build workload.
resourcePlan.inputBounds: Small synthetic files/rows/images and finite deterministic worker responses for exhaustive UI branching; reuse existing task/source/byte/time limits.
resourcePlan.timing: Separate cold shell/Canvas readiness, warm UI input-to-paint and long-running inference/training delivery. Preserve existing budgets; establish any new local baseline prospectively with exact source, profile and workload before candidate optimization.
resourcePlan.memory: Keep actual RAM/VRAM/process/lease guards and supported model profile controls. No further guard lowering, offload lease or model-accuracy rerun is authorized by this UI plan.
resourcePlan.remainingOnly: Reuse exact source-matching passed evidence when admissible; rerun only missing relevant scenarios/changed regressions and the mandatory final current aggregate once. Source changes cannot relabel stale results current.
resourcePlan.cleanup: Own isolated profiles/listeners/processes; wait for confirmed exit and check setup/teardown. Preserve unknown staging/ownership and report explicit pending/blocked state.

statusSemantics.passed: Actual applicable assertions executed successfully on the bound source/profile.
statusSemantics.failed: An executed required assertion, setup, teardown or freshness check failed.
statusSemantics.blocked: Applicable technical evidence cannot run or qualify because its declared environment/authority is unavailable.
statusSemantics.not-run: Applicable work has not executed; it cannot satisfy closure.
statusSemantics.not-applicable: Exact implemented/ADR authority shows no supported mounted behavior on that host; include that reference. A missing desired feature is a finding, not a free skip.

ownerBoundaries.handling: Completed; reuse meaningful-system, cold Canvas and browse oracles. New UI roadmap extends missing regressions and current host coverage without reopening historical state.
Preserve model quality/resource and final qualification gaps. Use existing approved protocols and accepted historical evidence; UI fixture success does not replace real model evidence.

Add candidate-bound actual adaptive-state/explicit-override UI witness and link only if it meets representative-resource-and-usability-qualification. Latest direct-adapter 0.5B constrained CPU/GPU resource/structural evidence is support, not host UI or semantic-quality pass.

Reuse explicit profile UI and failure tests. Native guarded restart/accounting/protection and real offload outcomes stay in owning roadmap; do not acquire a lease or touch retained old staging to make this plan pass.
Reuse task/capability, creation matrix, row-review and publication protocols; crosslink new UI evidence, leave unavailable OCR/private-provider/advanced quality claims pending in owner.
Reuse actual asset authoring/reopen/native-zoom tests. Do not retry restricted independent legacy security review or imply current fixtures resolve native gaps.
Add only authorized functional denial regressions for changed paths. Security policy, native identity and restricted review remain separately owned; never duplicate or bypass blocked restricted work.
Current accepted behavior supersedes standalone Run & Test mounting. Reuse exact lifecycle driver and preserve automatic visual runtime launch.
Completed historical implementations; extend real UI create/review/query/rebuild/delete evidence with existing artifact/model protocols, not a second Context pipeline.

ownerScopeClarification: Physical native/offload, model semantic accuracy, private-provider operations and restricted independent review retain their existing owners. This UI roadmap requires its own applicable actual host assertions and truthful UI readiness/denial, not those roadmaps to close. New valid UI evidence may be linked later only through each owner current qualification process.

securityImpact.summary: The proposed harness drives authenticated API/IPC, credentials, untrusted files/packages/model output, persistence and runtime side effects. Preparation changes documentation only; implementation must preserve every authority and isolation boundary.
assets: Synthetic test artifacts and exact immutable provenance
Model/provider secrets and private user content excluded from retained evidence
Owned host processes, files and resource budgets
trustBoundaries: Browser/renderer to authenticated API or sender-bound preload/IPC
Untrusted source/package/model content to inert UI preview
Runner to disposable host/profile and sanitized evidence
abuseCases: A fixture bypasses auth or injects hidden composition and falsely qualifies user workflow
Traces/screenshots retain tokens, prompts or private data
Cancellation or restart deletes unknown old stage or loses owned worker
Repeated external publication/download consumes authority not granted
A skipped/empty/failing child is reported as complete
controls: Use actual mounted UI and public typed boundaries with least privilege synthetic fixtures
Finite scenario/operation allowlists and contained disposable owned profiles
Keep resource admission and safe-weight integrity unchanged unless separately reviewed
Disable sensitive capture and retain finite numeric/status metadata
No new provider/model/dependency/native-effect authority from test planning
Keep fixture, actual host, physical runtime and external qualification separate
verification: Positive plus denial/malformed/stale/scope/failure behavior at each owned boundary
Safe evidence schema/path/content checks and runner failure/empty/teardown regressions
Current source-bound executed receipts and genuine independent review per increment
Threat model delta and safe rollback reviewed before each product fix
residualRisks: Physical native/offload protection, unavailable provider credentials and model capacity cannot be proven by UI fixtures
Restricted security review remains outside agent authority
New product capabilities uncovered by tests require separate explicit scope decisions

completionPolicy: control-plane-v1; completionSuite all; no roadmap approval or implementation is created by this proposal.
nextCheckpoint: Publish exact existing strategy approval and this full roadmap through serialized source-claimed work, execute documentation/roadmap/agent-support checks, obtain genuine separate planning review and present the complete roadmap for actual approval before implementation.
